principle: A nonexistent original is generated by fabricating the complete machinery of its recovery, where dense documented transmission substitutes for the source itself and the deliberately undocumented final link keeps the promised original permanently suspended beyond verification.

nodes.label: Found-manuscript frame with amputated recovery link
nodes.description: The narrative is presented as an edited translation of a recovered codex, with every internal transmission link documented except the final link to the modern editor, which is deliberately omitted. The terminal void reads as active negative space precisely because everything else is specified.
evidence: Prologue and Note on the Shire Records present the entire text as a recovered, edited codex.
Unlike Otranto or Cide Hamete conventions, the chain from Middle-earth to the modern editor is never narrated; the frame terminates in a void.
Stage 4 validation: the Red Book is this frame; remove it and no freestanding work remains.
rules: Every internal transmission link is documented with scribal precision while the final link is never documented
The original must never be produced; verification stays permanently deferred one stratum beyond reach

nodes.label: Layered composite authorship
nodes.description: The text is attributed in dated strata to Bilbo, Frodo, Sam, and later scribes, with visible seams such as crossed-out titles and blank final leaves reserved for a successor hand. Serialized attribution is what makes the object a codex rather than a generic frame-tale.
evidence: Explicit stratified attribution: Bilbo's memoir, Frodo's continuation, Sam's additions, Bilbo's three volumes of Translations from the Elvish.
Diegetic composition scenes, including the title-page sequence in The Grey Havens.
Stage 4 validation: palimpsest, open edge, and errata absorption all hang off the serialized strata.
rules: Every stratum must be attributed and dated to a named hand
Only testimony accessible to the attributed hobbit witnesses is admissible

nodes.label: Translation-layer disguise
nodes.description: Appendix F declares the English surface a systematic substitution for invented source languages, with Westron rendered as English and Rohirric as Old English, so the reader is told the shown text is never the original. This is the frame's central claim to reality.
evidence: Appendix F specifies systematic substitution: Westron as English, Rohirric as Old English, hobbit-names anglicized.
Subtraction test: removing the translation claim collapses nomenclature logic and reduces the appendices to trivia.
The declared mediation converts the surface text into a disguise over an unrecoverable original.
rules: Every word of the surface text is a systematic substitution for the source language

nodes.label: Pseudo-editorial apparatus
nodes.description: Appendices A-F, dual calendar systems, genealogical tables, the Tale of Years, and translator footnotes form a scholarly armature attached to the narrative, supplying the checkable substrate the translation claim requires.
evidence: Appendices A-F, dual calendars in Appendix D, genealogies, Tale of Years in Appendix B, translator footnotes are all concretely present.
Stage 4 validation flags density rather than existence as the questionable part; a thinner armature might arguably suffice.
Stage 2: remove the appendices and the translation claim has no referent.

nodes.label: Transmission stemma as fabricated patina
nodes.description: The Note on the Shire Records specifies copies and recensions: the Thain's Book, Findegil's Minas Tirith copy, later interpolations such as the tale of Aragorn and Arwen, and annotations in multiple hands, simulating manuscript wear and variance.
evidence: Named recensions: Thain's Book, Findegil's copy, specified interpolations and marginalia.
Stage 2: the stemma creates the category of manuscript variance that errata absorption then fills.
Stage 4: amplifies authentication and makes the amputated final link legible as void.

nodes.label: Errata absorption via riddle-game reconciliation
nodes.description: The discrepancy between the 1937 and 1951 versions of the riddle-game chapter is reconciled diegetically: Bilbo's lie is recorded as the original entry, corrected in later recensions, converting real-world revision into fictional manuscript variance.
evidence: The riddle-game revision is explicitly reframed as recension history within the fiction.
Stage 4: brilliant but opportunistic, exploiting a single real-world instance; the frame stands without it.
Stage 3: validates the witness by convicting it of perjury, inverting provenance's conventional purpose.
rule_violations: Provenance evidence conventionally certifies witness reliability

nodes.label: Title-page palimpsest
nodes.description: In The Grey Havens the manuscript's title page displays crossed-out serial titles before Frodo's final title, rendering revision marks visible as seams between attributed strata rather than suppressing them.
evidence: Concrete single scene: crossed-out titles from My Diary through There and Back Again.
Stage 4 classifies it as an incidental single-instance flourish since stratum boundaries are established by attribution elsewhere.

nodes.label: Blank final leaves reserved for Sam
nodes.description: Frodo leaves the final pages blank for Sam, making the manuscript's terminal boundary an open edge, structurally unfinished by design; the theme of succession is written into the codex as unwritten pages.
evidence: Frodo explicitly reserves the last pages for Sam.
Stage 2: form becomes content, since the open edge is the mechanism of the ending itself.
Stage 4: converts the ending into apparatus, but the frame survives its removal.

nodes.label: Recursive self-citation at Cirith Ungol
nodes.description: Characters anticipate the book from inside it: Sam and Frodo discuss being put into songs and tales, and Sam imagines a reader demanding more about Sam, so the container appears within its contents at micro scale.
evidence: Cirith Ungol dialogue about songs and tales explicitly anticipates the containing book.
Stage 2: a scale model of the whole frame's container-inside-contents logic.
Stage 4 classifies it as incidental, removable without collapse.

nodes.label: English verse, rhyme, and wordplay
nodes.description: Poems and songs whose rhyme, meter, and puns operate by aesthetic self-sufficiency in English; they cannot be translations of Westron, so they refuse the system's claim of total derivativeness while remaining load-bearing for the text as literature.
evidence: Stage 3: English rhyme, meter, and puns cannot be translations of a source language.
The refusal is load-bearing: stripping the verbal pleasure to honor the conceit would make the text fail as literature.
rule_violations: Every word of the surface text is a systematic substitution for the source language

nodes.label: Scenes beyond hobbit testimony
nodes.description: The prose narrates Gollum's private deliberations, councils no hobbit attended, and Boromir's death from perspectives no attributed witness could reach; the apparatus patches some breaches with debriefings but not all.
evidence: Stage 3: the memoir frame is systematically violated by its own content.
Named instances: Gollum's private deliberations, unattended councils, Boromir's death.
The frame survives by not pressing its own evidentiary standard.
rule_violations: Only testimony accessible to the attributed hobbit witnesses is admissible

nodes.label: Appendix B Tale of Years continuation
nodes.description: Appendix B narrates past the blank final leaves, documenting Sam's departure and the end of the age within the same binding, closing elsewhere the open edge the blank leaves promise.
evidence: Stage 3: the codex simultaneously withholds and delivers its continuation.
Appendix B documents events beyond the point where the manuscript is declared unfinished.

edges.rationale: The translation conceit requires the appendical apparatus to supply an original substrate; remove the appendices and the translation claim has no referent.
Without the translation conceit the appendices become trivia; each makes the other's claim checkable, and each becomes inert without the other.
The amputated terminal link reads as active void only if all internal transmission links are documented with exhaustive scribal precision; the stemma supplies that density.
Errata absorption requires the transmission stemma to pre-establish the category of manuscript variance, otherwise the reconciliation is an ad hoc patch.

The title-page palimpsest carries load only because composite authorship already serializes the text into attributed strata; crossed-out titles are legible as stratum boundaries only under serialized attribution.
The blank final leaves read as the next stratum awaiting deposit rather than narrative failure only because composite authorship serializes the text into attributed strata.
A title page displaying successive hands establishes the precedent that lets the blank leaves for Sam read as an awaited stratum; the open edge survives without the palimpsest.

Producing the original would make the frame falsifiable, so the translation claim's authority depends on the amputated recovery link keeping verification permanently deferred one stratum beyond reach.
If apparatus density decreases below narrative need, the frame reverts to decoration and the documented feel of the world degrades; density of the armature sustains the frame's authority.
Real-world revision converted into recension history deposits an actual variant into the stemma; Bilbo's recorded lie becomes proof the manuscript exists, supplying warrant for the recovery frame.
Characters anticipating the book from inside it is a scale model of the frame's container-inside-contents logic; it strengthens the frame but is removable without collapse.
Serialized attributed strata make the recovered object a specific codex rather than a generic frame-tale; stripping composite authorship leaves only a generic frame, which still stands.
The eyewitness memoir contract limits admissible perspective, and every scene beyond hobbit testimony strains the frame it cannot fully patch.
If the translation claim is enforced on the verse, its rhyme, meter, and wordplay become impossible, so the frame must tolerate untranslated aesthetic self-sufficiency.
The open-edge promise of unwritten succession is contradicted by Appendix B, which narrates past the blank leaves within the same binding.

The stemma's named recensions and interpolations are strata deposited by attributed hands; without serialized composite authorship there are no distinct hands for copies and annotations to descend from.

violated: Only testimony accessible to the attributed hobbit witnesses is admissible

failure_modes.consequence: The memoir frame breaks whenever the prose narrates scenes no attributed witness could access, such as Gollum's private deliberations, unattended councils, and Boromir's death; the frame survives only by not pressing its own evidentiary standard.

violated: The original must never be produced; verification stays permanently deferred one stratum beyond reach

failure_modes.consequence: The authentication loop is circular: every checkable claim terminates in fabricated evidence, so any demand to actually produce the original falsifies the frame and collapses the system, as historically demonstrated by the Ossian case.

violated: Every word of the surface text is a systematic substitution for the source language

failure_modes.consequence: The verse contradicts the total-derivativeness claim, since English rhyme and puns cannot be translations; the frame must conceal a load-bearing exception, and enforcing the rule on the verse would make the text fail as literature.

Kept in place, Appendix B closes the open edge the blank leaves promise, narrating Sam's departure within the same binding; the codex simultaneously withholds and delivers its continuation, a contradiction the frame conceals rather than resolves.

violated: Provenance evidence conventionally certifies witness reliability

failure_modes.consequence: Reliability is manufactured from documented unreliability: the frame convicts its own witness of lying in order to prove the manuscript exists, inverting provenance's conventional purpose while trading on its authority.

Without documented internal links the amputated terminal link reads as mere omission rather than active void, errata absorption becomes an ad hoc patch, and the frame's authentication degrades toward decoration.

Removing either half of the co-dependent pair inertifies both: without the translation conceit the appendices become trivia, and without the appendices the translation claim has no checkable referent; nomenclature logic and the documented feel of the world collapse.

asserted_removal_tests.M1: If removed, no work remains at all, since there is no freestanding text beneath the frame device.
asserted_removal_tests.M2: If removed, the codex collapses into a generic frame-tale and the palimpsest, open-edge ending, and errata absorption lose their attachment points.
asserted_removal_tests.M3: If removed, the nomenclature logic collapses and the appendices become inert trivia with no original substrate to reference.
asserted_removal_tests.M4: If removed, the translation claim loses its referent and the fabricated provenance becomes an unverifiable assertion rather than a simulated evidence system.
